title: Integrations
unavailable: Integrations are not available in this setup.

signin.title: Sign in to connect apps
signin.body: Sign in to Houston to connect your apps. Your accounts stay yours; the agent acts on your behalf.
signin.failed: Sign-in couldn't start. Please try again.

reconnectNotice: We upgraded how apps connect to make it more secure. Please reconnect your apps once; Houston no longer keeps any long-lived key for them.

connectResult.timeout: We stopped checking for now. When you finish signing in, connect {{app}} again.
connectResult.unavailable: The Houston team still needs to finish setting up this app. Please check back soon.
connectResult.noAuth: This app works without an account, so there is nothing to connect.
connectResult.failed: Something went wrong while signing in. Please try connecting it again.

disconnect.confirmBody: This removes {{name}} for all of your agents, not just this one. You can reconnect it anytime.

waiting.title: Finish connecting {{app}}
waiting.body: We opened {{app}} in your browser. Sign in there, then come back here.
waiting.blockedBody: We could not open {{app}} for you. Open it yourself to sign in, then come back here.
waiting.stopped: We stopped checking on {{app}}. Connect it again when you are done.

pendingRecovery.body: You started connecting {{app}} but did not finish signing in.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.disconnectBody: This removes the {{account}} account from {{name}} for all of your agents. Your other {{name}} accounts stay connected.

custom.description: Connect an API or MCP server that isn't in the app catalog.
custom.empty: No custom integrations yet. Add one to connect a tool that isn't in the catalog.
custom.noResults: No custom integrations match your search.
custom.catalogUnavailable: The app catalog isn't available in this setup, but you can still add custom integrations.
custom.loadError: We couldn't load your custom integrations.

add.title: Add a custom integration
add.chatDesc: Tell your agent what you want to connect and it walks you through everything in chat.
add.manualDesc: Paste an API or MCP server address and fill in the details yourself.

detected.unknown: We couldn't recognize this address. Check the URL, or let your agent help you in chat.
detected.mcpOauth: This server signs in with its own account (OAuth), which Houston can't connect to yet. An API key won't work here.
detected.mcpOauthOk: This MCP server uses its own sign-in. After adding it, you'll sign in in your browser.

add.needsKeyDesc: Turn this on if the service asks for a key or token. You'll enter it securely right after adding.

details.activeBody: Connected and working. Your agents can use its actions in any chat.
details.pendingBody: Waiting for an API key. Enter the key to switch it on.
details.pendingSignInBody: This integration is waiting for you to sign in. Press Sign in and finish in your browser.

status.pendingSignIn: Waiting for you to sign in

keyDialog.title: Enter the key for {{name}}
keyDialog.description: Your key is stored securely and never shown in chat.
keyDialog.savedUnverifiedToast: Key saved for {{name}}. The service hasn't confirmed it yet.

delete.title: Remove {{name}}?
delete.description: Your agents will lose access to its actions. This can't be undone.

setupChat.bannerTitle: You are setting up a custom integration in chat
setupChat.bannerDescription: Pick up where you left off, or discard the draft chat.
setupChat.doneToast: Nice! Your custom integration is ready to use.

oauth.openedToast: Finish signing in to {{name}} in your browser

croma.description: Official government records from Colombia, Peru and Mexico: look up court cases, companies, vehicles and people, with answers backed by official sources.
croma.keyHelp: Sign in to your Croma workspace and copy an API key (it starts with croma_live_). Keys belong to your organization's workspace, not a personal account.

highlevel.description: Your HighLevel (GoHighLevel) CRM: contacts, conversations, pipelines and opportunities, calendars, invoices and payments, social posts and blogs. Each connection works with one sub-account.
highlevel.signInDesc: HighLevel's official connection. Your browser opens a page labeled LeadConnector, HighLevel's technical name. Choose the sub-account your agents should work with and approve.
highlevel.providerDesc: Connects through Composio, with every HighLevel feature. When HighLevel opens, use the dropdown next to Houston to switch Agency View to Sub-Account View, then approve.

connect.title: Connect {{name}}
connect.signInDesc: The easiest way: your browser opens and you sign in to your {{name}} account. No key to copy.
connect.keyDesc: Paste a key from your {{name}} account.
connect.newTo: New to {{name}}? Create your account first, then come back here to connect.
